description: Verify FramingUI wiring in a project. Runs the skill's doctor script against projectPath and reports pass/warn/fail checks on the setup (theme CSS variables, component availability, project config). Covers the free scope of FramingUI (editorial-tech theme + 30 components). Exit code 0 = healthy, 1 = problems found.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory to check.

name: framingui_doctor
title: FramingUI doctor
